summary: The kit's two trust levels. A host may declare more in a document keeping the same contract.

levels.says: A server this host runs or whose publisher it answers for: every declared effect is allowed, an undeclared tool is asked about.

A server whose content may carry instructions (the web, third-party data): only its read tools are allowed; its write and exec tools are denied, and an undeclared tool is unavailable where the product can say so.
